title: Speaking: Connectors & Fluent Phrases
sub: Linking words and adverbs that make speech smooth and natural.

cards.def:
In addition; further to what was said.
हिंदी: इसके अलावा
examples: Present: He is skilled; moreover, he is honest.
Past: She was late; moreover, she forgot the files.
Future: The plan is cheap; moreover, it will save time.
Perfect: He has finished; moreover, he has checked it twice.

cards.def:
Also; used to add a stronger point.
हिंदी: इसके अतिरिक्त
examples: Present: The car is fast; furthermore, it is safe.
Past: He left early; furthermore, he took the keys.
Future: The scheme will help; furthermore, it will create jobs.
Perfect: They have agreed; furthermore, they have signed.

cards.def:
Used to introduce a contrasting statement.
हिंदी: हालाँकि
examples: Present: It is cheap; however, it is slow.
Past: We tried; however, we failed.
Future: It may rain; however, we will go.
Perfect: He has apologised; however, I am still upset.

cards.def:
In spite of that.
हिंदी: फिर भी
examples: Present: It is hard; nevertheless, I enjoy it.
Past: He was tired; nevertheless, he kept going.
Future: It will be difficult; nevertheless, we will try.
Perfect: She has failed; nevertheless, she remains hopeful.

cards.def:
As a result.
हिंदी: परिणामस्वरूप
examples: Present: Prices rise; consequently, people spend less.
Past: He missed the bus; consequently, he was late.
Future: Rain will fall; consequently, the match will stop.
Perfect: She has worked hard; consequently, she has improved.

cards.def:
For that reason.
हिंदी: इसलिए
examples: Present: I think; therefore, I am.
Past: It was raining; therefore, we stayed home.
Future: He is ill; therefore, he will miss the trip.
Perfect: They have moved; therefore, the address has changed.

cards.def:
At the same time, elsewhere.
हिंदी: इस बीच
examples: Present: He cooks; meanwhile, she sets the table.
Past: He studied; meanwhile, I watched TV.
Future: You wait here; meanwhile, I will park.
Perfect: Prices have risen; meanwhile, wages have stalled.

cards.def:
If not; in different circumstances.
हिंदी: वरना
examples: Present: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss it.
Past: He left early; otherwise he would have met her.
Future: Study hard, otherwise you will fail.
Perfect: I have locked the door; otherwise anyone could enter.

cards.def:
Despite the fact that.
हिंदी: यद्यपि
examples: Present: Although it is cold, I enjoy winter.
Past: Although he was tired, he finished.
Future: Although it will rain, we will go.
Perfect: Although she has tried, she has not succeeded.

cards.def:
In contrast to the fact that.
हिंदी: जबकि
examples: Present: He likes tea, whereas she likes coffee.
Past: He was calm, whereas she was angry.
Future: Rural areas will grow, whereas cities will shrink.
Perfect: She has finished, whereas he has not started.

cards.def:
Without being affected by.
हिंदी: के बावजूद
examples: Present: Despite the noise, I can concentrate.
Past: Despite the rain, we played.
Future: Despite the cost, we will buy it.
Perfect: Despite her efforts, she has not won.

cards.def:
Used to emphasise the truth.
हिंदी: वास्तव में
examples: Present: In fact, I agree with you.
Past: In fact, he never came.
Future: In fact, it will be cheaper.
Perfect: In fact, she has already gone.

cards.def:
Actually; to tell the truth.
हिंदी: असल में
examples: Present: As a matter of fact, I like it.
Past: As a matter of fact, I was there.
Future: As a matter of fact, I will join you.
Perfect: As a matter of fact, I have met him.

cards.def:
Used to present an opposite point.
हिंदी: दूसरी ओर
examples: Present: It is cheap; on the other hand, it is fragile.
Past: He was kind; on the other hand, he was strict.
Future: Cities offer jobs; on the other hand, they will cost more.
Perfect: She has talent; on the other hand, she lacks discipline.

cards.def:
Showing a clear difference.
हिंदी: इसके विपरीत
examples: Present: In contrast, the south is dry.
Past: In contrast, the earlier model failed.
Future: In contrast, the new plan will succeed.
Perfect: In contrast, sales have grown abroad.

cards.def:
Because of what has just been mentioned.
हिंदी: नतीजतन
examples: Present: As a result, prices rise.
Past: As a result, the match was cancelled.
Future: As a result, taxes will increase.
Perfect: As a result, many have lost jobs.

cards.def:
Used to introduce an example.
हिंदी: उदाहरण के लिए
examples: Present: For instance, tea is cheaper.
Past: For instance, he missed two classes.
Future: For instance, we will visit Jaipur.
Perfect: For instance, she has read ten books.

cards.def:
Especially.
हिंदी: विशेष रूप से
examples: Present: I like fruit, in particular mangoes.
Past: He was upset, in particular by her words.
Future: I will thank, in particular, the volunteers.
Perfect: She has impressed, in particular, the judges.

cards.def:
Also; as an extra.
हिंदी: इसके अलावा
examples: Present: In addition, there is a fee.
Past: In addition, she paid the deposit.
Future: In addition, we will offer discounts.
Perfect: In addition, they have opened a branch.

cards.def:
Used to conclude briefly.
हिंदी: सारांश में
examples: Present: In summary, the plan is sound.
Past: In summary, the trip went well.
Future: In summary, we will start Monday.
Perfect: In summary, the team has done well.

cards.def:
Used to give your real opinion.
हिंदी: ईमानदारी से कहूँ तो
examples: Present: To be honest, I disagree.
Past: To be honest, I did not like it.
Future: To be honest, I will not attend.
Perfect: To be honest, I have never tried it.

cards.def:
Used to add a new, related remark.
हिंदी: वैसे
examples: Present: By the way, I met your sister.
Past: By the way, he called yesterday.
Future: By the way, I will be late tomorrow.
Perfect: By the way, have you seen my phone?

cards.def:
Used to change topic or return to a point.
हिंदी: ख़ैर / किसी भी तरह
examples: Present: Anyway, let's begin.
Past: Anyway, he left in the end.
Future: Anyway, we will decide tomorrow.
Perfect: Anyway, I have said what I wanted.

cards.def:
Used to give true or surprising information.
हिंदी: दरअसल
examples: Present: Actually, I prefer tea.
Past: Actually, I met him last year.
Future: Actually, I will do it myself.
Perfect: Actually, I have already paid.

cards.def:
In the most important respects.
हिंदी: मूलतः
examples: Present: Basically, it is a simple idea.
Past: Basically, he refused.
Future: Basically, we will wait.
Perfect: Basically, nothing has changed.

cards.def:
In a way that is easy to see.
हिंदी: ज़ाहिर है
examples: Present: Obviously, health matters most.
Past: Obviously, she was upset.
Future: Obviously, it will take time.
Perfect: Obviously, he has been practising.

cards.def:
As it seems or is said.
हिंदी: प्रत्यक्षतः / कहा जाता है
examples: Present: Apparently, it is a good film.
Past: Apparently, he left early.
Future: Apparently, it will rain tomorrow.
Perfect: Apparently, she has resigned.

cards.def:
Used when you assume something is true.
हिंदी: संभवतः
examples: Present: Presumably, he knows the way.
Past: Presumably, she missed the call.
Future: Presumably, they will arrive soon.
Perfect: Presumably, he has forgotten.

cards.def:
In an honest and direct way.
हिंदी: साफ़-साफ़
examples: Present: Frankly, I am not impressed.
Past: Frankly, he was rude.
Future: Frankly, I will not agree.
Perfect: Frankly, she has been unfair.

cards.def:
By good luck.
हिंदी: सौभाग्य से
examples: Present: Fortunately, help is near.
Past: Fortunately, no one was hurt.
Future: Fortunately, the weather will clear.
Perfect: Fortunately, she has recovered.

cards.def:
By bad luck.
हिंदी: दुर्भाग्य से
examples: Present: Unfortunately, shops close early.
Past: Unfortunately, he missed the train.
Future: Unfortunately, it will be delayed.
Perfect: Unfortunately, they have lost the keys.

cards.def:
After a long time.
हिंदी: अंततः
examples: Present: Eventually, everyone leaves.
Past: Eventually, he agreed.
Future: Eventually, you will understand.
Perfect: Eventually, she has found work.

cards.def:
At the beginning.
हिंदी: शुरू में
examples: Present: Initially, plans seem easy.
Past: Initially, I disagreed.
Future: Initially, we will test it.
Perfect: Initially, he has hesitated.

cards.def:
Slowly, step by step.
हिंदी: धीरे-धीरे
examples: Present: Gradually, habits form.
Past: Gradually, the pain faded.
Future: Gradually, prices will fall.
Perfect: Gradually, she has improved.

cards.def:
At once.
हिंदी: तुरंत
examples: Present: Immediately, the alarm rings.
Past: He replied immediately.
Future: I will call immediately.
Perfect: She has left immediately.

cards.def:
Sometimes, but not often.
हिंदी: कभी-कभार
examples: Present: I occasionally go to the cinema.
Past: He occasionally visited us.
Future: She will occasionally call.
Perfect: We have occasionally met.

cards.def:
All the time.
हिंदी: लगातार
examples: Present: Prices constantly change.
Past: She constantly complained.
Future: He will constantly check it.
Perfect: They have constantly argued.

cards.def:
Not often.
हिंदी: शायद ही कभी
examples: Present: I rarely eat sweets.
Past: He rarely spoke in class.
Future: She will rarely refuse.
Perfect: They have rarely met.

cards.def:
Only just; hardly.
हिंदी: मुश्किल से
examples: Present: I barely know him.
Past: She barely escaped.
Future: He will barely finish.
Perfect: We have barely started.

cards.def:
Almost not.
हिंदी: मुश्किल से ही
examples: Present: I hardly slept.
Past: He hardly spoke.
Future: We will hardly notice.
Perfect: She has hardly eaten.

cards.def:
Only; nothing more.
हिंदी: केवल
examples: Present: It is merely a rumour.
Past: He merely smiled.
Future: She will merely observe.
Perfect: They have merely begun.

cards.def:
Almost; nearly.
हिंदी: लगभग
examples: Present: It is virtually impossible.
Past: The road was virtually empty.
Future: The task will be virtually finished.
Perfect: She has virtually recovered.

cards.def:
Especially.
हिंदी: ख़ासकर
examples: Present: I like soups, particularly in winter.
Past: He was particularly kind.
Future: It will be particularly cold.
Perfect: She has been particularly helpful.

cards.def:
In a surprising or notable way.
हिंदी: उल्लेखनीय रूप से
examples: Present: She remarkably remembers everything.
Past: He performed remarkably well.
Future: It will remarkably change things.
Perfect: The team has done remarkably.

cards.def:
To a large or important degree.
हिंदी: काफ़ी हद तक
examples: Present: Prices vary significantly.
Past: Sales rose significantly.
Future: Costs will fall significantly.
Perfect: She has improved significantly.

cards.def:
Around; not exactly.
हिंदी: लगभग
examples: Present: It costs approximately fifty rupees.
Past: About ten came approximately.
Future: The trip will take approximately two hours.
Perfect: He has waited approximately an hour.

cards.def:
In the order mentioned.
हिंदी: क्रमशः
examples: Present: A and B scored ten and twelve respectively.
Past: They won first and second respectively.
Future: Rates will be five and six percent respectively.
Perfect: Ages have been twenty and thirty respectively.

cards.def:
Used for emphasis after negatives.
हिंदी: बिल्कुल भी
examples: Present: I have no doubt whatsoever.
Past: There was no sign whatsoever.
Future: There will be no change whatsoever.
Perfect: He has shown no interest whatsoever.

cards.def:
In total; completely.
हिंदी: कुल मिलाकर
examples: Present: It costs fifty altogether.
Past: He stopped altogether.
Future: We will abandon the plan altogether.
Perfect: She has quit altogether.

cards.def:
In the same way.
हिंदी: उसी तरह
examples: Present: She smiled; likewise, he did.
Past: He agreed; likewise, I did.
Future: You will help; likewise, we will.
Perfect: She has paid; likewise, he has.

cards.def:
In place of something.
हिंदी: इसके बजाय
examples: Present: I drink tea instead of coffee.
Past: He walked instead.
Future: We will take the train instead.
Perfect: She has chosen to stay instead.

cards.def:
Also; in addition.
हिंदी: इसके अलावा
examples: Present: It is late; besides, I'm tired.
Past: He lied; besides, he stole.
Future: I will go; besides, it's free.
Perfect: She has paid; besides, she brought food.

cards.def:
Taking everything into account.
हिंदी: कुल मिलाकर
examples: Present: Overall, the plan works.
Past: Overall, the trip was good.
Future: Overall, results will improve.
Perfect: Overall, she has done well.

cards.def:
Used to introduce specific details.
हिंदी: यानी
examples: Present: Two skills matter, namely speed and accuracy.
Past: He had one fear, namely heights.
Future: We will visit three cities, namely Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur.
Perfect: She has two aims, namely to learn and to teach.

cards.def:
As a consequence.
हिंदी: इसलिए
examples: Present: Prices fell; hence demand rose.
Past: He lied; hence she doubted him.
Future: Costs will rise; hence profits will drop.
Perfect: Rain has fallen; hence the fields are green.

cards.def:
In this way; as a result.
हिंदी: इस प्रकार
examples: Present: Practice daily; thus you improve.
Past: He worked hard; thus he passed.
Future: Taxes will fall; thus spending will rise.
Perfect: She has trained; thus she is ready.

cards.def:
In a way that suits the situation.
हिंदी: तदनुसार
examples: Present: Read the rules and act accordingly.
Past: He acted accordingly.
Future: We will respond accordingly.
Perfect: They have adjusted accordingly.

cards.def:
In a way worth noting.
हिंदी: विशेष रूप से
examples: Present: Several leaders attended, notably the mayor.
Past: Many failed, notably the leaders.
Future: Prices will rise, notably for fuel.
Perfect: Many have helped, notably the volunteers.

cards.def:
Soon, or at the present time.
हिंदी: फ़िलहाल / शीघ्र
examples: Present: He will arrive presently.
Past: She joined us presently.
Future: I will join you presently.
Perfect: He has arrived presently.

cards.def:
Despite everything.
हिंदी: बिना परवाह किए
examples: Present: Regardless, we will go.
Past: He continued regardless.
Future: She will proceed regardless.
Perfect: They have carried on regardless.

cards.def:
Used to admit a point that weakens your argument.
हिंदी: यह मानना पड़ेगा
examples: Present: Admittedly, it is expensive.
Past: Admittedly, I was wrong.
Future: Admittedly, it will take time.
Perfect: Admittedly, I have made mistakes.

cards.def:
According to claims, not proven.
हिंदी: कथित रूप से
examples: Present: He allegedly took the money.
Past: She allegedly lied to police.
Future: He will allegedly face charges.
Perfect: The firm has allegedly cheated customers.

cards.def:
According to reports.
हिंदी: सूत्रों के अनुसार
examples: Present: He is reportedly ill.
Past: The deal was reportedly signed.
Future: The star will reportedly marry.
Perfect: Talks have reportedly collapsed.

cards.def:
According to what is believed.
हिंदी: कथित तौर पर
examples: Present: It is supposedly safe.
Past: He supposedly left at noon.
Future: It will supposedly open soon.
Perfect: She has supposedly resigned.

cards.def:
In a way that is clear to see.
हिंदी: स्पष्ट रूप से
examples: Present: Evidently, he is upset.
Past: Evidently, she knew the answer.
Future: Evidently, they will agree.
Perfect: Evidently, nothing has changed.

cards.def:
Without doubt.
हिंदी: निस्संदेह
examples: Present: She is undoubtedly gifted.
Past: He was undoubtedly guilty.
Future: It will undoubtedly succeed.
Perfect: She has undoubtedly improved.

cards.def:
Without doubt; of course.
हिंदी: निश्चित रूप से
examples: Present: It is certainly useful.
Past: He certainly tried.
Future: I will certainly help.
Perfect: She has certainly grown.

cards.def:
Most likely.
हिंदी: संभवतः
examples: Present: It will probably rain.
Past: He probably forgot.
Future: She will probably call.
Perfect: They have probably left.

cards.def:
Perhaps.
हिंदी: शायद
examples: Present: I can possibly join you.
Past: He possibly missed the train.
Future: She will possibly resign.
Perfect: It has possibly changed.

cards.def:
Without any doubt.
हिंदी: निश्चित रूप से
examples: Present: I will definitely come.
Past: She definitely saw it.
Future: It will definitely work.
Perfect: He has definitely improved.

cards.def:
Apparently; as it seems.
हिंदी: प्रतीत होता है
examples: Present: A seemingly simple task.
Past: He seemingly ignored her.
Future: It will seemingly end soon.
Perfect: She has seemingly left.

cards.def:
In a firm and exact way.
हिंदी: सख़्ती से
examples: Present: Strictly speaking, it is wrong.
Past: He followed rules strictly.
Future: Rules will be enforced strictly.
Perfect: The school has banned phones strictly.

cards.def:
Mainly.
हिंदी: मुख्यतः
examples: Present: He works primarily at night.
Past: It was designed primarily for kids.
Future: The money will primarily go to schools.
Perfect: She has focused primarily on teaching.

cards.def:
At the most basic level.
हिंदी: मूलतः
examples: Present: It is essentially a game.
Past: He essentially quit.
Future: It will essentially remain the same.
Perfect: They have essentially agreed.

cards.def:
In the end.
हिंदी: अंत में
examples: Present: Ultimately, the choice is yours.
Past: Ultimately, he failed.
Future: Ultimately, the truth will emerge.
Perfect: She has ultimately decided.

cards.def:
Before now.
हिंदी: पहले
examples: Present: He previously worked abroad.
Past: She previously lived in Pune.
Future: I will previously inform you.
Perfect: They have previously met.

cards.def:
After that.
हिंदी: तत्पश्चात
examples: Present: He subsequently resigned.
Past: She was subsequently promoted.
Future: He will subsequently be informed.
Perfect: They have subsequently agreed.

cards.def:
At the same time.
हिंदी: एक साथ
examples: Present: Two events happen simultaneously.
Past: They spoke simultaneously.
Future: Two trains will arrive simultaneously.
Perfect: Both have finished simultaneously.

cards.def:
In a polite and respectful way.
हिंदी: सम्मानपूर्वक
examples: Present: She speaks respectfully to elders.
Past: He respectfully declined.
Future: I will respectfully disagree.
Perfect: She has respectfully asked.

cards.def:
In a keen way.
हिंदी: उत्सुकता से
examples: Present: Children eagerly await holidays.
Past: She eagerly accepted the offer.
Future: Fans will eagerly wait.
Perfect: He has eagerly joined.

cards.def:
In an unwilling way.
हिंदी: अनिच्छा से
examples: Present: He reluctantly agrees.
Past: She reluctantly left.
Future: He will reluctantly accept.
Perfect: They have reluctantly signed.

cards.def:
Completely and carefully.
हिंदी: पूरी तरह
examples: Present: She thoroughly checks her work.
Past: He thoroughly enjoyed it.
Future: We will thoroughly inspect it.
Perfect: She has thoroughly prepared.

cards.def:
Smoothly and easily, especially in speech.
हिंदी: धाराप्रवाह
examples: Present: She speaks English fluently.
Past: He answered fluently.
Future: You will speak fluently with practice.
Perfect: She has learned to read fluently.

cards.def:
With self-assurance.
हिंदी: आत्मविश्वास से
examples: Present: She speaks confidently.
Past: He answered confidently.
Future: You will present confidently.
Perfect: She has handled it confidently.

cards.def:
In a way that is easy to understand.
हिंदी: स्पष्ट रूप से
examples: Present: Speak clearly.
Past: She explained it clearly.
Future: He will state it clearly.
Perfect: I have understood clearly.

cards.def:
In a few words; for a short time.
हिंदी: संक्षेप में
examples: Present: Briefly explain your idea.
Past: He spoke briefly.
Future: She will briefly summarise.
Perfect: I have briefly mentioned it.

cards.def:
With attention to avoid mistakes.
हिंदी: सावधानी से
examples: Present: Drive carefully.
Past: She read the contract carefully.
Future: He will listen carefully.
Perfect: They have planned carefully.

cards.def:
In a courteous way.
हिंदी: विनम्रता से
examples: Present: Ask politely.
Past: He politely refused.
Future: She will politely decline.
Perfect: He has politely asked.
